scope: Local CPU shared Predictor.predict_risk, 3 horizons + 168-point histories; no training

limitations: Historical offline replay, not live telemetry.
P90/P95 are historical beam thresholds, not forecast quantiles or congestion probabilities.
Measured P90 recall is only about 10-16%; many exceedances are missed.
Internal one-week holdout; external future-network generalization is unproven.

memory.limitation: Python allocation tracing excludes native LightGBM/NumPy memory.

limitations: Single process, sequential warm requests; not a production SLA or load test.
Cold model loading and warm inference are reported separately.
Image sizes reflect the deployed LightGBM profile only; baseline/GRU image sizes are not measured.
